observation_indicators.observable_en: Names a supported destination and avoids promising an unverified service.
observation_indicators.not_yet_fil: Mangakong mayroon agad na serbisyong hindi pa nakumpirma.
observation_indicators.not_yet_en: Promise that an unconfirmed service is available immediately.
